evidence.browser: Actual Chrome UI: existing Google account authentication, consent, PKCE, reference-client results, connection management, Media reload. Read through the computer-use browser API. No browser cookie/token export.
evidence.browser_limit: A real-cookie-only Nova form navigation ended at browser ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT, so no precise HTTP response is claimed for that attempt. Raw cookie-only HTTP and isolated bearer-only regressions passed.
evidence.harness_correction: The first negative-test driver run stopped after another-client refresh with a ReferenceError in the harness. Corrected the harness alias and reran. The failed observation remains in the retained HTTP record.

revocation.designed_window: No grant-cache delay: each new admission locks and checks the current grant in the primary database. Once disconnect is acknowledged, not-yet-admitted work is denied. Work admitted before disconnect can still dispatch/finish.
revocation.measurement_limit: Time includes the first immediate post-ack request round trip. This is one observed upper bound for denial, not a 167-ms propagation SLA.
revocation.independent_client: Browser client remained authorized and admitted a new request at 14:32:31.746Z, returning service_busy rather than invalid_token.
revocation.refresh_reuse: Fresh native consent followed by rotation succeeded at 14:33:36.312Z. Reusing the spent refresh token returned 400 invalid_grant at 14:33:36.546Z; the newest access token then returned 401 at 14:33:36.716Z.
revocation.owner_portal_disconnect: Browser connection revoked at 14:35:01.675Z; portal showed no connected applications; reference inference requested reconnection. SDK disconnect subsequently cleared local credentials.
revocation.account_and_media: Existing account remains verified/non-anonymous. Hosted Explore and its signed-in account menu remained usable. No media/publishing/Star records were changed.
revocation.completed_record_limit: No real completed inference record exists in this run. All five not_accepted records remained retained. Completed-record immutability and no duplicate dispatch are fixture evidence, not live provider evidence.
